verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a dedicated sandbox at demo.ramp.com with a separate API base (demo-api.ramp.com) for building and testing "without affecting live production data," with "no real money movement." It also includes simulation hooks (⌘ J demo actions panel), a CLI that connects to the sandbox by default, and a demo-data MCP endpoint (demo-mcp.ramp.com) for agent testing. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (no probe of the sandbox/demo endpoints, no community reports of using it).
